system.description:
You take a step back and then push forward attempting to strike. Make a melee attack against a creature in range, dealing your [Weapons damage] + 3d8 on a hit. Regardless, if your attack is successful or not, you can move up to 10 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity until the end of the current turn.

Chain 1: You cannot make this attack with disadvantage.

Chain 2: The affected creatures next attack is made at disadvantage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8.
